targets.query:
from(bucket: "vehicle")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vehicle_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "soc_pct")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> yield(name: "soc_pct")

from(bucket: "vehicle")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vehicle_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "range_km")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> yield(name: "range_km")

from(bucket: "vehicle")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trips")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "avg_speed_kmh")
  |> drop(columns: ["trip_index", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "avg_speed_kmh")

from(bucket: "vehicle")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trips")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "max_speed_kmh")
  |> drop(columns: ["trip_index", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "max_speed_kmh")

from(bucket: "vehicle")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trips")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "distance_km")
  |> drop(columns: ["trip_index", "_start", "_stop"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "distance_km")
